title: Model route option record
description: A normalized record for one cheap, balanced, quality-first, or local-first pipeline route option.
review_triggers: human safety or regulated-domain review required
example_use: Search for the cheapest reviewed route for image-plus-text exploitation triage.

title: Prompt prefix cache profile
description: A stable prompt, tool, schema, and rubric prefix profile that can be reused across route options and providers with prompt caching support.
review_triggers: cache profile may include tenant secrets
example_use: Estimate cost savings for standardized guardrail and output-schema prefixes.

title: Pricing snapshot stub
description: A run-scoped placeholder for live model, runtime, storage, queue, embedding, and human-review pricing before production lookup is available.
review_triggers: missing live pricing before production deployment
example_use: Compare simulated local demo costs while clearly marking estimates as non-production.

title: Verified fact dependency record
description: A dependency edge from a generated blueprint to a signed or verified fact object, including jurisdiction, effective dates, and impact-routing metadata.
example_use: Find pipelines affected when a government updates employment agency fee rules.

title: A/B cost-quality eval arm
description: An evaluation arm for a route option with cost ceiling, quality metrics, stop rules, and promotion criteria.
review_triggers: high-risk arm promoted without human review
example_use: Promote the cheapest route that clears false-negative and review-quality gates.
